title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Jumps To Record High On Strong Q3 Results
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL) Jumps To Record High On Strong Q3 Results 8/1/2018 9:43 AM ET
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) reported third quarter EPS of $2.34 after the bell Tuesday, which surpassed the street estimate of $2.18. Revenues rose 17 percent to $53.27 billion from last year's $45.41 billion. Analysts expected revenues of $52.34 billion.
Apple has gapped open sharply higher Wednesday morning and is now up 7.95 at $198.24. The stock has leaped to a new high for the year.
